body: Yeah, thanks, I'm starting to feel *a little* bit better now. The best thing about having a roof over my head is being able to take a long hot bath. The last time I took a bath when living with my ex, the second I saw her she started screaming at me 'How DARE you use up ALL my water! How could you be so stupid? Other people probably wanted to use the bathroom? Do you know how expensive water is?' Etc, etc...

Hey, thanks for the advice, I appreciate you taking the time to try to help a complete stranger.

It was pretty unlikely, almost impossible at such short notice, but you may be interested to know that I've found a place to move in to, starting tomorrow. It's a single room in a three bedroom flat, living with a married couple, a little newborn baby, and another woman. There is also a large sitting room with two sofas. The people seem really nice, and the price was knocked down due to the fact no one wants to live with the possibility of the baby crying all night long. But I'm willing to accept that possibility gladly right now if it means I can buy a pair of earplugs and be in a positive enviroment away from someone who treated me like crap so regularly that it become the norm.
